
{{alias}}( options )
    Returns a legend instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object
        Options.

    options.aria: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG
        output. Default: true.

    options.clipHeight: number (optional)
        Height (in pixels) to clip symbol legend entries and limit their size.

    options.columnPadding: number (optional)
        Horizontal padding (in pixels) between symbol legend columns.

    options.columns: number (optional)
        Number of columns in which to arrange symbol legend entries.

    options.cornerRadius: number (optional)
        Corner radius for the full legend.

    options.description: string (optional)
        Legend description. Default: ''.

    options.direction: string (optional)
        Direction of the legend. Default: 'vertical'.

    options.encode: Object (optional)
        Mark encodings for custom legend styling.

    options.fill: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to a fill color.

    options.fillColor: string (optional)
        Background fill color for the full legend.

    options.format: string|Object (optional)
        Format specifier for legend labels.

    options.formatType: string (optional)
        Type of format to use for legend scales which do not have a strict
        domain data type.

    options.gradientLength: number (optional)
        Length (in pixels) of the primary axis of a color gradient.

    options.gradientOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of the color gradient.

    options.gradientStrokeColor: string (optional)
        Stroke color of the color gradient border.

    options.gradientStrokeWidth: number (optional)
        Stroke width of the color gradient border.

    options.gradientThickness: number (optional)
        Thickness (in pixels) of the color gradient.

    options.gridAlign: string (optional)
        Grid alignment for legend entries. Default: 'each'.

    options.labelAlign: string (optional)
        Horizontal text alignment of legend labels.

    options.labelBaseline: string (optional)
        Vertical text baseline of legend labels.

    options.labelColor: string (optional)
        Text color for legend labels.

    options.labelFont: string (optional)
        Font name for legend labels.

    options.labelFontSize: number (optional)
        Font size (in pixels) of legend labels.

    options.labelFontStyle: string (optional)
        Font style of legend labels.

    options.labelFontWeight: string|number (optional)
        Font weight of legend labels.

    options.labelLimit: number (optional)
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of legend labels.

    options.labelOffset: number (optional)
        Offset (in pixels) between legend labels and their corresponding symbol
        or gradient.

    options.labelOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of legend labels.

    options.labelOverlap: boolean|string (optional)
        Strategy for resolving overlapping legend labels in gradient legends.
        Default: true.

    options.labelSeparation: number (optional)
        Minimum separation between legend label bounding boxes for them to be
        considered non-overlapping. Default: 0.

    options.legendX: number (optional)
        Custom `x` position (in pixels) for the legend group.

    options.legendY: number (optional)
        Custom `y` position (in pixels) for the legend group.

    options.offset: number|Object (optional)
        Offset (in pixels) by which to displace the legend from the data
        rectangle and axes.

    options.opacity: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to an opacity value.

    options.orient: string (optional)
        Legend orientation. Default: 'right'.

    options.padding: number|Object (optional)
        Padding (in pixels) between legend border and content of the legend
        group.

    options.rowPadding: number (optional)
        Vertical padding (in pixels) between symbol legend entries.

    options.shape: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to a shape value.

    options.size: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to a size value.

    options.stroke: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to a stroke color.

    options.strokeColor: string (optional)
        Border stroke color for the full legend.

    options.strokeDash: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to a stroke dash value.

    options.strokeWidth: string (optional)
        Name of the scale that maps to a stroke width value.

    options.symbolDash: Array<number> (optional)
        Stroke dash for symbol outlines. Default: [].

    options.symbolDashOffset: number (optional)
        Pixel offset at which to start the symbol stroke dash array.

    options.symbolFillColor: string (optional)
        Fill color of legend symbols.

    options.symbolLimit: number (optional)
        Maximum number of entries for a symbol legend.

    options.symbolOffset: number (optional)
        Horizontal pixel offset for legend symbols.

    options.symbolOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of legend symbols.

    options.symbolSize: number (optional)
        Default symbol area size (in squared pixels).

    options.symbolStrokeColor: string (optional)
        Stroke color of legend symbols.

    options.symbolStrokeWidth: number (optional)
        Default stroke width of legend symbols.

    options.symbolType: string (optional)
        Default symbol shape type for legend entries.

    options.tickCount: number|string|Object (optional)
        Desired number of tick values for quantitative legends.

    options.tickMinStep: number (optional)
        Minimum desired step between tick values (in the same units as scale
        domain values).

    options.title: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Legend title.

    options.titleAlign: string (optional)
        Horizontal text alignment of the legend title.

    options.titleAnchor: string|null (optional)
        Legend title anchor position. Default: null.

    options.titleBaseline: string (optional)
        Vertical text baseline of the legend title.

    options.titleColor: string (optional)
        Text color of the legend title.

    options.titleFont: string (optional)
        Font name of the legend title.

    options.titleFontSize: number (optional)
        Font size of the legend title.

    options.titleFontStyle: string (optional)
        Font style of the legend title.

    options.titleFontWeight: string|number (optional)
        Font weight of the legend title.

    options.titleLimit: number (optional)
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of the legend title.

    options.titleLineHeight: number (optional)
        Line height (in pixels) for multi-line title text.

    options.titleOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of the legend title.

    options.titleOrient: string (optional)
        Orientation of the legend title. Default: 'top'.

    options.titlePadding: number|Object (optional)
        Padding (in pixels) between the legend title and entries.

    options.type: string (optional)
        Legend type.

    options.values: ArrayLikeObject (optional)
        Explicit set of legend values.

    options.zindex: integer (optional)
        Integer z-index indicating the layering of the legend group relative to
        other axis, mark, and legend groups. Default: 0.

    Returns
    -------
    legend: Legend
        Legend instance.

    legend.aria
        Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG
        output.

    legend.clipHeight
        Height (in pixels) to clip symbol legend entries and limit their size.

    legend.columnPadding
        Horizontal padding (in pixels) between symbol legend columns.

    legend.columns
        Number of columns in which to arrange symbol legend entries.

    legend.cornerRadius
        Corner radius for the full legend.

    legend.description
        Legend description.

    legend.direction
        Direction of the legend.

    legend.encode
        Mark encodings for custom legend styling.

    legend.fill
        Name of the scale that maps to a fill color.

    legend.fillColor
        Background fill color for the full legend.

    legend.format
        Format specifier for legend labels.

    legend.formatType
        Type of format to use for legend scales which do not have a strict
        domain data type.

    legend.gradientLength
        Length (in pixels) of the primary axis of a color gradient.

    legend.gradientOpacity
        Opacity of the color gradient.

    legend.gradientStrokeColor
        Stroke color of the color gradient border.

    legend.gradientStrokeWidth
        Stroke width of the color gradient border.

    legend.gradientThickness
        Thickness (in pixels) of the color gradient.

    legend.gridAlign
        Grid alignment for legend entries.

    legend.labelAlign
        Horizontal text alignment of legend labels.

    legend.labelBaseline
        Vertical text baseline of legend labels.

    legend.labelColor
        Text color of legend labels.

    legend.labelFont
        Font name for legend labels.

    legend.labelFontSize
        Font size (in pixels) for legend labels.

    legend.labelFontStyle
        Font style of legend labels.

    legend.labelFontWeight
        Font weight of legend labels.

    legend.labelLimit
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of legend labels.

    legend.labelOffset
        Offset (in pixels) between legend labels and their corresponding symbol
        or gradient.

    legend.labelOpacity
        Opacity of legend labels.

    legend.labelOverlap
        Strategy to use for resolving overlapping legend labels in gradient
        legends.

    legend.labelSeparation
        Minimum separation (in pixels) between legend label bounding boxes for
        them to be considered non-overlapping.

    legend.legendX
        Custom `x` position (in pixels) for the legend group.

    legend.legendY
        Custom `y` position (in pixels) for the legend group.

    legend.offset
        Offset (in pixels) by which to displace the legend from the data
        rectangle and axes.

    legend.opacity
        Name of the scale that maps to an opacity value.

    legend.orient
        Legend orientation.

    legend.padding
        Padding (in pixels) between legend border and content of the legend
        group.

    legend.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    legend.rowPadding
        Vertical padding (in pixels) between symbol legend entries.

    legend.shape
        Name of the scale that maps to a shape value.

    legend.size
        Name of the scale that maps to a size value.

    legend.stroke
        Name of the scale that maps to a stroke color.

    legend.strokeColor
        Border stroke color for the full legend.

    legend.strokeDash
        Name of the scale that maps to a stroke dash value.

    legend.strokeWidth
        Name of the scale that maps to a stroke width value.

    legend.symbolDash
        Stroke dash for symbol outlines.

    legend.symbolDashOffset
        Pixel offset at which to start the symbol stroke dash array.

    legend.symbolFillColor
        Fill color of legend symbols.

    legend.symbolLimit
        Maximum number of entries for a symbol legend.

    legend.symbolOffset
        Horizontal pixel offset for legend symbols.

    legend.symbolOpacity
        Opacity of legend symbols.

    legend.symbolSize
        Default symbol area size (in squared pixels).

    legend.symbolStrokeColor
        Stroke color of legend symbols.

    legend.symbolStrokeWidth
        Default stroke width of legend symbols.

    legend.symbolType
        Default symbol shape type for legend entries.

    legend.tickCount
        Desired number of tick values for quantitative legends.

    legend.tickMinStep
        Minimum desired step between tick values (in the same units as scale
        domain values).

    legend.title
        Legend title.

    legend.titleAlign
        Horizontal text alignment of the legend title.

    legend.titleAnchor
        Legend title anchor position.

    legend.titleBaseline
        Vertical text baseline of the legend title.

    legend.titleColor
        Text color of the legend title.

    legend.titleFont
        Font name of the legend title.

    legend.titleFontSize
        Font size (in pixels) of the legend title.

    legend.titleFontStyle
        Font style of the legend title.

    legend.titleFontWeight
        Font weight of the legend title.

    legend.titleLimit
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of the legend title.

    legend.titleLineHeight
        Line height (in pixels) for multi-line title text.

    legend.titleOpacity
        Opacity of the legend title.

    legend.titleOrient
        Orientation of the legend title.

    legend.titlePadding
        Padding (in pixels) between the legend title and entries.

    legend.type
        Legend type.

    legend.values
        Explicit set of legend values.

    legend.zindex
        Integer z-index indicating the layering of the legend group relative to
        other axis, mark, and legend groups.

    legend.toJSON()
        Serializes a legend instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var opts = { 'fill': 'colorScale' };
    > var legend = new {{alias}}( opts )
    <Legend>
    > legend.orient
    'right'

    // Set a property:
    > legend.title = 'Legend Title';
    > legend.title
    [ 'Legend Title' ]

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > legend.toJSON()
    {...}

    --------
